notes.title: Farming Simulator 2013: DLCs Pack
notes.content:
[url=http://store.steampowered.com/sub/41048/]Farming Simulator 2013: DLCs Pack[/url] for Farming Simulator 2013® or Farming Simulator 2013® Titanium Edition brings a harvest of new content for your game including vehicles and machinery and tutorials to create your own content.

• WITH OVER 30 NEW VEHICLES AND ITEMS OF FARMING EQUIPMENT enjoy new possibilities to develop your farm using your new spreaders, trailers, slurry tanks and more! Faithfully reproduced from the four famous brands: Marshall, Lindner, Ursus and Väderstad. Drive the new Lindner Multipurpose Tractor available with its own exchangeable modules

• DISCOVER A SERIES OF VIDEO TUTORIALS which will explain how to create and add your own content to the game. Create vehicles, machines and scenery and share them with the community

>> http://store.steampowered.com/sub/41048/ <<

[code]<iframe width="640" height="360" src="//www.youtube.com/embed/W7jJTpza_v8" frameborder="0" allowfullscreen></iframe>[/code]

notes.title: Patch 2.0.0.9
notes.content:
Hello,

The patch 2.0.0.9 is now avaible for PC and MAC:
[list][*]Fixed issues with retina MacBooks (2.0)
[*]Fixed loading of the highest bidder of an auction in a savegame (2.0)
[*]Fixed Amazone UX5200 multiplayer folding issue (2.0)
[*]Fixed Poettinger Eurocat315H folding animation (2.0)
[*]Fixed rare resetting ShopScreen issue when starting new mission (2.0)
[*]Fixed shop brand list issue when loading new mods on second game load (2.0)
[*]Fixed minor AO baking issue on Horsch Terrano (2.0)
[*]Fixed multiplayer between Steam and non-Steam version with the classics DLC (2.0)[/list]
For more details from previous patch:
http://farming-simulator.com/updates.php

Enjoy the game,
Thierry
